REVIEW FAIL (code): Fabricated thread receipt persisted as Slack root - FR-003 (Scoped dispatch, threads and click auth).
  WHERE: src/application/project-routing/index.ts:300-319
  EXPECTED: deliverProjectEvent binds a feature thread only from a receipt the NotificationPort returned with a real Slack messageTs. A void notify result yields { delivered: false } or an unbound delivery and never calls bindFeatureThread.
  ACTUAL: `(result as NotificationReceipt) ?? { delivered: true, channelId, messageTs: input.nowIso }` then `bindFeatureThread({ rootTs: receipt.messageTs })`. Repro: notificationPort { async notify() {} } with featureId "999-new" and nowIso "2026-11-18T10:00:00.000Z" persists rootTs "2026-11-18T10:00:00.000Z". The production adapter src/adapters/notifications/index.ts:14 returns Promise<void>, so every first lifecycle event would bind an ISO string as thread_ts and break later replies and click verification.
  FIX: Remove the synthesized receipt fallbacks at lines 246-251, 266-271 and 302-308. Treat a void result as `{ delivered: false }` or as delivered-without-ts, and bind the thread only when the port returns messageTs. Add a test in src/server/slack-actions.test.ts or a new project-routing test with a void-returning port asserting getFeatureThread stays null.

Run pnpm exec biome check --write and add tests for same-feature foreign thread collision and slug-based deliverProjectEvent.
